subject: ACME private deploy: subnet stitching, liveness scans, and runbook verification
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Network stitch and liveness plan for ACME go-live

Team —

We are T-24h from the ACME private deployment activation window. This thread is to consolidate the final checklist and schedule the liveness/traffic-sanity pass that Security asked for before we flip. High-level objectives:

- Verify VPC peering / subnet stitching between ACME transit and their on-prem firewall (bounced routes validated)
- KV-cache priming across the edge nodes for the 1M token warm path
- Service liveness probes (HTTP 200/200+ latency checks) for inference, control-plane, and metrics exporters
- Evidence bundle for SOC review: runbook (v3), smoke logs, routing evidence

Schedule (draft):
- 12:00 UTC: routing verify + ACL sample checks (Marissa)
- 12:30 UTC: kv priming and cache snapshot (Karthik)
- 13:00 UTC: liveness sweep and synthetic traffic (Mina/Laura)
- 14:00 UTC: SOC evidence package assembled and uploaded to Drive

Attachments: runbook_v3.pdf (last edit 05/23), quick checklist inlined below.

Quick checklist (to tick in bridge):
- BGP session established and neighbor down/up history clear
- Transit route table has ACME prefixes present in both regions
- Firewall rules allow service ports 443/4433 and ephemeral ranges used by our edge
- KV priming completed with at least one full-request path per model variant
- Prometheus exporter scrape success for all inference pods for >3 consecutive intervals

Ask: please confirm your availability for the schedule above and flag any risk that would block the window. Jordan — if you want us to shift the start by an hour, say so now.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: runbook_v3.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 09:42:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Network stitch and liveness plan for ACME go-live

On Thu, May 24, 2028 at 9:13 AM Mina Haddad wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We are T-24h from the ACME private deployment activation window...

All good from my side. I ran the ACL diff against last week's snapshot; the only unexpected change was an extra deny on the outbound ephemeral range on ACME-firewall-2. I pulled a temp exception with the customer (Jordan confirmed) and will push the relaxed rule at 11:55 UTC then validate.

Additional notes:
- I'll publish a short bridge run-order at 11:50 UTC so ops on-call knows the exact sequence.
- If we find asymmetric routing during the routing verify, we treat it as a hard block and pause activation.

Confirmed for the 12:00 schedule. I will attach my sanity diff to the drive folder after the 11:55 change.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Network Lead, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: acl_diff_20280524.txt (text/plain)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SaaS Ops Team <ops@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 10:05:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Network stitch and liveness plan for ACME go-live

Thanks Mina and Marissa —

We stand ready for the 12:00 UTC start. Confirmed exception applied to firewall-2 for the ephemeral range; Ops will monitor for any unexpected rejects. Our team will hold on-call in the ACME bridge and will provide packet captures if you ask for them during the routing checks.

One item from our security team: they requested the liveness sweep include a single replay of a red-team-style malformed header to ensure the edge rejects gracefully and logs a 4xx rather than a 500. We are ok with the test if you can confirm it won't trigger any automated rollback rules.

Jordan Ellis
Infrastructure Lead, ACME Financials

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 11:22:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Network stitch and liveness plan for ACME go-live

Quick technical addendum before the priming step:

- KV priming will run two passes: (1) cold-prefix warmup across edge-0..edge-3 using synthetic prompts; (2) variant-specific token stretch to exercise the attention cache for long-tail models. I will push the kv_warmup_snapshot.json to the drive after the second pass.
- The malformed-header test requested by ACME will be run in 'observe-only' mode (no rollback triggers) and will be rate-limited to one request per 30s window and tagged in logs as "acme-redteam-observe". That should satisfy their security ask but keep safety gates intact.
- If we observe any 5xx responses during the liveness sweep we will hold and initiate the incident triage play (runbook_v3.pdf section 4).

I'll be on the 12:30 slot and will paste the priming snapshot to the drive when done.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Lead Infra Eng, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: kv_warmup_snapshot.json (application/json)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACME go-live: execution summary and evidence upload

Wrap-up from today's activation window:

Summary:
- Routing verify (12:00 UTC): BGP sessions stable, no AS-path discrepancies. Marissa's ACL change applied at 11:55 UTC and validated; no asymmetric routing observed.
- KV priming (12:30 UTC): two passes completed; kv_warmup_snapshot.json shows >98% hit ratio for the warm path and KV warm durations within expected range.
- Liveness sweep (13:00 UTC): 1800 synthetic requests across models; 1796 returned 200; 4 returned 4xx from the malformed-header observe test (logged as acme-redteam-observe). No 5xx observed.
- Evidence: smoke_log_20280525.txt and runbook_v3.pdf uploaded to Drive folder and linked to JIRA INF-4821.

Decision: green — proceed with traffic flip at 15:00 UTC as planned. ACME acknowledged and accepted the evidence bundle.

Action items closed:
- Marissa: ACL diffs attached and archived.
- Karthik: KV snapshot uploaded.
- Laura: bridge notes and probe traces uploaded to Drive.
- Mina: assembled SOC evidence bundle and notified compliance.

Thanks everyone for the tight coordination. I'll leave the bridge open for 2 hours post-flip to handle any immediate anomalies.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: smoke_log_20280525.txt (text/plain), runbook_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
